articles.title: Coldcard's $38 million (so far) exploit shakes faith in self-custody, may push investors to ETFs
articles.snippet: A software bug in popular hardware wallet Coldcard that led to the theft to this point of nearly 600 bitcoin worth roughly $38 million is prompting questions about security and whether managing private keys has become too risky for everyday investors.

articles.title: Circle secures New York trust charter as crypto regulatory push accelerates
articles.snippet: The approval lets the USDC issuer offer fiduciary and custody services under New York banking law.

articles.title: ​Traders brace for an August crypto pull-back as protection against $60,000 bitcoin dip becomes top trade
New York sues Kalshi, alleges it offers a gambling platform 'plain and simple'
articles.snippet: The suit wants to bar the company from operating what it says is an unlicensed gambling business and seeks financial redress.

articles.title: Ex-FTX users report funds being released in $900M distribution round
articles.snippet: Several users of the long-defunct crypto exchange reported that distribution agents had begun releasing funds to reimburse creditors for some of their 2022 losses.
